headline: OpenAI launches Dots AI agent at DevDay as a rival to Muse
summary: At its DevDay keynote, OpenAI launched Dots, an always-on AI agent pitched as a rival to Meta's Muse, running across connected apps to pursue tasks continuously. Sam Altman said OpenAI won't go public until its models are safe; outlets differ on whether a separate new model launch was scrapped or merely delayed.
